Explore a cozy, hand-drawn world where color brings life back! Join Luna the hedgehog in a heartwarming 2D adventure filled with puzzles.

Chromascape is a top-down 2D adventure set in a soft, atmospheric world where you solve puzzles using the power of "color."

■ Palette Planet: A World Sustained by Color

On Palette Planet, the flowers, the trees, and the residents themselves once lived in the embrace of color.
But now, a phenomenon known as the "Color Loss" has begun.
As the colors slowly fade from the world, the residents have also started to disappear without a trace.

■ Receive and Share

One day, Luna the hedgehog discovers she holds a special power.
With this gift, she can restore hues to objects that have lost them and reactivate dormant forces.
Throughout her journey, she uses this power to bring life back to her surroundings.

■ Journey with Friends

The companions you meet along the way all possess unique talents.
By borrowing their strength and working together, Luna can overcome obstacles and reach places she could never explore alone.

■ A Gentle Adventure Woven by Color

Warm colors may become fire to light up the darkness.
Cool colors might freeze flowing water to create a new path.
Deciding which color to bestow, and where, is the key to solving the puzzles.

Now it is up to you to help the Tricky Truck by bridging the gaps and helping it safely cross to the other side.Don't worry as the Tricky Truck can call upon his friends to help complete this task.Put on your smart cap and win through these trials and prove that you are the brightest friend they got.? FEATURES:----------------------- Easy drag, drop and tap game play- Overcome the challenge in each level to unlock the next.- Physics handling and dynamics give an exciting puzzle game experience- Theme based graphics and music enhance the efficacy of the gaming experience.- A fine challenge for hand eye co-ordination, balance and logic.- Level timer to increase the climax and difficulty for each level.- Score functionality to challenge yourself to be better.- Bang, Boom and Destruction to increase gameplay experience.- Screen movement to add a better visual to the landscape experience?How to Play:----------------------- The objective is to place the hurdles in the gaps to allow the truck a safe path to its destination.- There are multiple ways of completing a level; try and find the best way.- Position and align the hurdles as fast as you can to make sure you get a high score.- Each level has a different impact on the truck, the art is to understand the speed and weight of the truck.- Make sure the placement of hurdles is accurate otherwise the truck will crash.- Failure to complete the task in the given time means that you will have to try again.- You can complete the hurdles by calling for help from the Dumper, Bulldozer and others.Disclaimer:This Game is Ad Supported!socialinkstudio@gmail.comTricky Truck Kids is a part of our other panorama of games such as Bridge the Train, Parrot Pet Shop, Crazy Balance 1, Crazy Balance 2, Grand Car Town Workshop, Kids Pics Art, Tennis Masters Championship and many more.

games.name: Tower of Insolence
games.summary: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

games.name: Ultraquarium
games.summary: ULTRAQUARIUM is a casual aquarium sim that lets you create your own fish and decorations. Purchase fish, satisfy their needs and they shall repay you in kind. Want two Gregs? You can't have two Gregs.

games.name: Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler
games.summary:
Unrivaled Heroes: 2.5D Brawler is 2.5D side-scrolling beat-'em-up where players experience the thrill of multiple unrivaled heroes, each with unique abilities. Master martial arts, unleash powerful skills, and conquer epic bosses. With local co-op for up to 4 players, team up for intense combat and a truly unforgettable adventure.

Set in medieval Indonesia, this game transports players to an era where powerful kingdoms ruled over vast archipelagos. Inspired by Indonesian folklore and mythology, legendary tales come to life through epic battles, brought together with stunning visuals that blend 2D and 3D elements.

Every chapter unfolds a new story, introducing fresh challenges, characters, and environments to explore. As the journey progresses, uncover deeper lore and unexpected twists that shape the world around you.

games.name: Unseam kiss for Violet Rose
games.summary: 《漱蛹绫吻-Unseam Kiss for Violet Rose》是一款视觉小说 讲述了芙翩纱拥有进入他人梦境的能力 她为了回忆与自己失踪的青梅竹马宁嚣逭的点点滴滴而拜访了一位少女的梦境 她请求对方在梦中重新构造出与青梅竹马曾经的日常 只是 凭借单凭她口中宁嚣逭的碎片 并不足以拼凑起一个完整的形象 至此 两人便沿着那些零落的痕迹 拼凑着她尚未成形的归处 在游戏中 你将见证芙翩纱尝试找回她的青梅竹马的故事

games.name: Vitro : Bloodstream
games.summary: Vitro: Bloodstream is a satisfying action-upgrade game where you guide a targeting field through a living bloodstream - neutralize evolving biological threats, earn Bio Energy, and adapt your procedure with research, boosts, auxiliaries, and permanent upgrades.

games.name: VoidCraft
games.summary: A real-time space strategy MMO where your colony keeps working, your fleets keep moving, and the galaxy remembers every choice. Travel in real time, watch every battle resolve, raid and ally across one living galaxy that resets every 6 months. Free to play. No pay-to-win, ever. Steam, iOS & Android.

games.name: Whoever Left the Light On
games.summary: Do you love word games? Are you looking for a new game to play with your friends? Try Lexigo!The Lexigo app is unlike any other word game out there. It combines spelling challenges with strategy. - The game features six-sided tiles that you use to spell words. - You can spell your words in a twisty path, if you like. You can move in six different directions. And you can even backtrack to use letters more than once in the same word!- One of the challenges of Lexigo is that each new word you spell has to start with the last letter of your previous word.Lexigo is a game for two to four players. Play online with your friends using Facebook or email. Or get a group together for a pass-and-play game in your living room!Earn Lexigold to buy exciting powerups. The game features nine powerups, including: POP – removes a selected letter tile from the grid. KICK – lets you boot an opponent’s pawn off the grid and then place it anywhere on the grid you like. FREEZE – freezes a letter tile and any other tiles touching it so that no one can use them.NUKE – blows up the entire grid and gives you a new starting grid.

games.name: Zoollision
games.summary: Roll into Zoollision as adorable animal balls in 1v1 collision duels and chaotic 2-6 player races, unlock more animals and cosmetics, and build your own zoo-themed roster.

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary:
Experience the brutal horror of Emergence Day through the eyes of Marcus Fenix in the origin story of one of gaming's most acclaimed sagas.​ 

Fourteen years before Gears of War, war heroes Marcus Fenix and Dom Santiago return home to face a new nightmare: the Locust Horde. These subterranean monsters, grotesque and relentless, erupt from below, laying siege on humanity itself. ​

Built from the ground up with Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers unprecedented graphical fidelity.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary:
1499. Paris is engulfed as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows.

Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, Trevor Belmont’s successor ventures into the burning streets and the looming castle to hunt down the beasts.

Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation...?

Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow a young Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: Phantom Blade Zero
games.summary: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.
